videos.caption: Chocolate Cobbler: Ingredients:  For the Cobbler: 1/2 cup (114g) unsalted butter 1/2 cup (106g) dark brown sugar, packed 1 1/2 cup (188g) all purpose flour 2 Tsp (10g) baking powder Pinch of salt 1/3 cup (67g) granulated sugar 1/2 cup (50g) dutch processed cocoa 1 cup (236ml) milk 1 Tbsp (20g) vanilla paste 1 cup (170g) semi-sweet chocolate chips Topping: 2 cups (402g) granulated sugar 3/4 cup (80g) dutch processed cocoa powder 1 1/2 cup (354ml)  boiling water Instructions: 1. Preheat the oven to 350F(176C), place your butter into a 9X9 baking dish. Place it in the oven till the butter is melted. Set aside. 2. Mix your flour, brown sugar, baking powder, granulated sugar, cocoa and salt in a large bowl.  3. Whisk in the milk, vanilla until combined. Fold in the chocolate chips. 4. Pour the batter over the melted butter and gently spread it carefully across the baking dish.  5. In a separate bowl, whisk your sugar and cocoa for your topping. Evenly spread it over the cobbler batter and pour the hot water over the topping. DO NOT MIX. 6. Bake for 55-60 minutes or until you can see a crust formed on top of the cobbler. Cool for 10 minutes and serve with vanilla ice cream or your favorite topping. #homecafe #dessert #chocolate #cobbler #falldesserts
